title: Rune Mysteries
start: Talk to Ariane in the lobby of the Wizards' Tower, south of Draynor Village.

requirements.t: Standard spells equipped or the ability to cast Spellbook Swap

recommended.t: Wicked hood or stardust for teleports to Wizards' Tower

rewards.t: Four new titles (speak to the Rune Guardian to retrieve the title):
If you are a member, you can talk to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum to receive 5 Kudos

steps.t: Talk to Ariane in the entrance to Wizards' Tower. [Chat: 1 What's happening here? › 2 What can I do to help? › Accept]
Head into the tower, pick up the Tower mindspike and attack the vortex with any spell. You must unequip any ranged, melee, or necromancy armour or you may not be able to lure the vortex.
Lure the vortex into the energy beam.
Talk to Ariane on the bridge outside. [Chat: 3 What do you want me to do? › 2 I'll get on it.]
Ascend the beam twice, and talk to Wizard Traiborn in the northwestern room. [Chat: 1 Have you seen anything unusual lately? › 2 In the power beam? › 2 Where do these things come from?]
Talk to Archmage Sedridor in the southern room. [Chat: 3 Ariane says the tower is in danger. › 3 What are you going to do? › 4 Goodbye.]

sub.t: If Love Story has been completed. [Chat: 4 Ariane says the tower is in danger. › 3 What are you going to do? › 4 Goodbye.]

steps.t: Talk to Wizard Ellaron in the northeastern room. [Chat: 2 Ariane says the tower is in danger. › 2 Thanks.]
Descend the beam twice or right-click and select bottom floor back to the floor 1.

Talk to Ariane. [Chat: 2 I've spoken to some of the wizards... › 3 Wizard Traiborn said something came through the library floor. › 2 Then let's get down there and investigate! › 2 I'll get right on it.]
Ascend the beam twice.

Talk to Wizard Ellaron. [Chat: 2 How can I get into the old tower? › 3 You do know, though? › 3 You mean the rumour about Water Surge? › 3 What do you mean, the key lies in understanding Water Surge? › 2 It's such a pity you couldn't help me, Maybe I'll visit the library.]
Go back to the floor 1 and search the easternmost bookcase for The Harmony of the Runes and The Runes of the Spells of Water.
Read the books.
Play the organ at the southern end of the floor 1.
Press the organ keys in the following order: 10x "B", 7x "A#", 1x "G#", and 1x "G". (small black keys are # notes)
Take the organ key.
Head to the north side of the island and talk to Ariane, [Chat: 2 I've got the key to the ruins. › Any] then head east and enter the door on the seashore.
Talk to Ariane [Chat: 2 We should keep our minds on the job. › 1 Yes, it's inspiring. › 2 Okay, what should we do now?]
Talk to the rune guardian and answer the questions any way. [Chat: 3 I'm ready to be tested. › Any › Any › Any › Any › Any]

sub.t: The options you pick only dictate the title you're given. See the full guide to learn more.

steps.t: Enter the door behind the rune guardian.
Walk down the stairs to the gap in front of Ariane.
Climb behind the statue (on the wall above the gap). [Chat: 1 I'm making us a bridge. › 1 Do you have a better idea?]
Cross the statue (gap) and climb down the staircase.
Talk to Ariane. [Chat: 1 I wish I could have seen it.]
Use magic to lure a vortex into Ariane's circle, and keep it there until the circle disappears. You can lure them by attacking them.
Talk to Ariane again. [Chat: 2 Never mind the history, what does that mean for us? › 2 Okay, so what do we do? › 3 Okay, I'll do that now.]
Exit the ruins.
Head back to the organ on the main floor of the tower and play any of the notes multiple times from the lowest set of keys to trigger several cutscenes.
Talk to Ariane (east side of the island at the entrance to the lower tower). [Chat: 3 Is there a reward?]
Quest complete!
